No note dominates; they blend harmoniously to create a sparkling, airy, and light opening. The heart reveals the creamy heliotrope and almond, supported by the strength of coffee and the elegance of Atlas cedar, while a hint of oud and sandalwood adds depth and texture. The fragrance transforms into a sensual and abstract embrace, where softness and character coexist in perfect harmony. The base culminates with an addictive blend of vanilla, musks, amber, tolu balsam, tonka bean, and labdanum, intensifying warmth and magnetism. The result is an intimate, seductive, and enveloping trail. Kisses Rain Labios Rotos is a rain of kisses for a modern love, evoking nostalgia, longing, and sweetness through its coffee accord. An insatiable perfume that invites the experience to be repeated again and again, leaving unforgettable memories. It embodies freshness, vitality, and youthful carefreeness, inviting you to live fully in the moment. This scent transports you to evenings and nights by the sea, where opportunities for romance don’t escape—they come knocking at your door. The opening blends lemon and petitgrain with Italian bergamot, delivering a wave of joy and setting the tone for a day full of possibilities. As it dries, semi-salty notes emerge, reminiscent of two sun-kissed bodies after a bath in the Caribbean: salty and sweet, floral and adventurous. The heart reveals lily of the valley, natural jasmine, a hint of leather, and seaweed, creating a sense of security, relaxation, and sensuality. The base with Ambroxan adds vibrancy and character, making Guanabo the sexiest, most energetic fragrance in our collection. Its name, in the Taíno language, means “small island in the middle of the sea,” inspired by the Guanabo beach in Habana del Este, Cuba.
